add.model: Ortlieb Atrack 35L（Ortlieb Atrack 35L 防水背包）
add.chineseName: Ortlieb Atrack 35L 防水背包
add.verdict: This is a pack that trekkers, bikepackers, ski-tourers, kayakers and packrafters can all genuinely rally behind.

add.model: Gregory Maven 58L（Gregory Maven 58L 女款背包）
add.chineseName: Gregory Maven 58L 女款背包
add.verdict: I think this bag could be a game-changer for me. Gregory have fine tuned the balance between support and practicality very well here, honing in on adjustability wherever possible.

add.model: Highlander Ben Nevis 52L（Highlander 本尼维斯 52L）
add.chineseName: Highlander 本尼维斯 52L
add.verdict: All in all this is a pack that has all the right details for life on the trail and that seems built to last. It's tough, it's stacked with handy details, the back system is comfortable and ventilating

add.model: Bach Molecule 45L（Bach 分子 45L）
add.chineseName: Bach 分子 45L
add.verdict: Tough and functional with some good eco efforts and neat pockets, this is a versatile pack that will suit a range of different trips. I've found it to be equally excellent for big treks where I'm carr

add.model: Sierra Designs Flex Capacitor 40-60L（Sierra Designs 弹性电容 40-60L）
add.chineseName: Sierra Designs 弹性电容 40-60L
add.verdict: I found it really comfortable to wear, even when it was heavily loaded, and I loved all of the handy details, including the stretchy pockets on the sides and across the harness.

add.model: Simond Trekking MT500 45+10L（Simond MT500 徒步背包 45+10L）
add.chineseName: Simond MT500 徒步背包 45+10L
add.verdict: 我喜欢这款背包的耐用性。虽然可回收材料不多，但面料本身非常结实，在小路上表现出色。背板也很透气，使用了悬浮网布和加固框架。

add.model: Osprey Talon 55L（Osprey 魔爪 55L）
add.chineseName: Osprey 魔爪 55L
add.verdict: 它舒适、方便，符合空气动力学设计，做工精良且耐用——给人一种能用很久的感觉。

add.model: Klättermusen Delling 25L（Klättermusen 巨人之刃 25L）
add.chineseName: Klättermusen 巨人之刃 25L
add.verdict: Delling 20L是一款做工精良、采用高品质材料的背包。在我最近的英国户外出行中表现非常可靠，Retina面料是一大亮点——它能让背包使用非常长的时间。

add.model: Fjällräven Keb 52L（Fjällräven Keb 52L）
add.chineseName: Fjällräven Keb 52L
add.verdict: 这款包的设计和做工非常出色，说它结实都算轻描淡写。从面料到拉链再到衬垫，每个细节的材料都令人惊叹。

add.model: Vaude Assymetric 52+8L（Vaude 非对称 52+8L）
add.chineseName: Vaude 非对称 52+8L
add.verdict: 这正是我喜欢徒步时背的那种耐用又轻量的背包。容量恰到好处，性价比也很高。环保设计很出色，完全没有影响性能，各处细节也很实用。

add.model: Scarpa Terra GTX（Scarpa Terra GTX 经典徒步靴）
add.chineseName: Scarpa Terra GTX 经典徒步靴
add.verdict: The Scarpa Terra GTX is a bit of a jack of all trades and master of none. I mean that in a good way, because we all need a pair of boots like these - they're the ones you end up wearing the most.

add.model: AKU Trekker Lite III（AKU Trekker Lite III 轻量徒步靴）
add.chineseName: AKU Trekker Lite III 轻量徒步靴
add.verdict: I'm always impressed with any boots that I get to try from AKU as the quality of craftsmanship is always really high and they're always comfortable on my feet. Fortunately, they haven't dropped the ba

add.model: Helly Hansen Ascender Mid HT（Helly Hansen Ascender Mid HT 轻量登山靴）
add.chineseName: Helly Hansen Ascender Mid HT 轻量登山靴
add.verdict: Lightweight and very comfortable, these boots make great light hikers and I've found that they perform best for three-season trail walking here in the UK.

add.model: Altberg Dalesway（Altberg Dalesway 环保登山靴）
add.chineseName: Altberg Dalesway 环保登山靴
add.verdict: Overall I was impressed by the performance, fit and craftsmanship of the Altberg Dalesway. The repairability element is particularly commendable and Altberg also deserve credit for offering an extensi

add.model: Haglöfs Skuta Mid Eco Proof（Haglöfs Skuta Mid Eco Proof 环保登山靴）
add.chineseName: Haglöfs Skuta Mid Eco Proof 环保登山靴
add.verdict: If you're looking for a boot that balances weight, protectiveness and value for money really well - this is the shoe I'd go for, especially in the muckier seasons.

add.model: Salomon X Ultra 360 Edge Mid（Salomon X Ultra 360 Edge Mid 越野徒步鞋）
add.chineseName: Salomon X Ultra 360 Edge Mid 越野徒步鞋
add.verdict: 这是我穿过的最舒适的靴子之一。贴合度非常好，足弓支撑出色，大大提升了舒适度。鞋头空间也很合适，不宽不窄，刚刚好。

add.model: Montbell Alpine Cruiser 800（Montbell Alpine Cruiser 800 高山靴）
add.chineseName: Montbell Alpine Cruiser 800 高山靴
add.verdict: Montbell Alpine Cruiser 800是一匹真正的工作马：稳定、支撑性好、做工精良的皮质高山徒步靴，负重和崎岖冬季地形下表现最佳。它不追求轻量或速度，它追求可靠性——并且做到了。

add.model: Hoka Kaha 2 GTX（Hoka Kaha 2 GTX 缓震登山靴）
add.chineseName: Hoka Kaha 2 GTX 缓震登山靴
add.verdict: 总的来说，Hoka Kaha 2是一款做工精良、用途广泛的三季登山靴，适合从简短轻松的徒步到多日长距离徒步的各种场景。

add.model: Asolo Acadia Mid LTH GTX（Asolo Acadia Mid LTH GTX 皮面登山靴）
add.chineseName: Asolo Acadia Mid LTH GTX 皮面登山靴
add.verdict: 这是一款我称之为'工作马'的登山靴——你会穿着它做各种事情，从长距离徒步、三季山地行走，到冬天在海滩遛狗甚至去商店买东西。

add.model: Keen Targhee IV（Keen Targhee IV 防水徒步靴）
add.chineseName: Keen Targhee IV 防水徒步靴
add.verdict: 总的来说，这是一款非常舒适的靴子，三季表现出色。我认为它非常适合春秋季的长距离徒步，也适合更日常的户外活动。

add.model: Brandecosse Volpe（Brandecosse Volpe 手工登山靴）
add.chineseName: Brandecosse Volpe 手工登山靴
add.verdict: 如果你计划冬季山地行走，或者你住的地方冬天小路会变成泥潭，这款靴子就是完美的选择。工艺精湛，给人一种经久耐用的感觉。

add.model: Hanwag Banks GTX（Hanwag Banks GTX 经典登山靴）
add.chineseName: Hanwag Banks GTX 经典登山靴
add.verdict: 我已经穿Hanwag Banks GTX一年多了，它已经成为我的首选，几乎每次山地或乡村徒步我都会穿它。

add.model: Salomon Quest 4 GTX（Salomon Quest 4 GTX 重装徒步靴）
add.chineseName: Salomon Quest 4 GTX 重装徒步靴
add.verdict: 这是一款极其舒适的靴子，在长距离徒步日表现出色。

add.model: Danner Mountain 600 EVO（Danner Mountain 600 EVO 都市徒步靴）
add.chineseName: Danner Mountain 600 EVO 都市徒步靴
add.verdict: 这些年我几乎测试过Danner所有的主要登山款式，据我所见，这是目前最完善的一款。

add.model: Helly Hansen Verglas Infinity Shell 2.0（Helly Hansen Verglas Infinity Shell 2.0 全天候冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Helly Hansen Verglas Infinity Shell 2.0 全天候冲锋衣
add.verdict: This is a reliable, highly functional shell with a lot of durability. It has an alpine-style cut, so it might be worth sizing up if you prefer a loose fit.

add.model: Simond Mountaineering Jacket（Simond 登山冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Simond 登山冲锋衣
add.verdict: Well cut, protective and durable - and at a very fair price. It has all the details you's want from a mountaineering jacket. It's on the heavy side, but I was really impressed with this jacket during

add.model: Páramo Caminata（Páramo Caminata 透气冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Páramo Caminata 透气冲锋衣
add.verdict: An unconventional form of wet weather protection that offers 'true breathability'. On the heavy side but there are lots of virtues here to make up for this.

add.model: Cimalp Guide Pro（Cimalp Guide Pro 耐用冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Cimalp Guide Pro 耐用冲锋衣
add.verdict: This is a technical shell that's ideal for demanding pursuits in harsh environments. Highly durable but the trade-off is that it's a touch on the heavy side.

add.model: Montbell Rain Trekker 2.0（Montbell Rain Trekker 2.0 轻量雨衣）
add.chineseName: Montbell Rain Trekker 2.0 轻量雨衣
add.verdict: 时尚且功能出色，重量和耐用性之间取得了极佳平衡。是三季长距离徒步的绝佳选择。遗憾的是没有腋下拉链通风口。

add.model: Teren Cloudland Shell（Teren Cloudland Shell 轻量冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Teren Cloudland Shell 轻量冲锋衣
add.verdict: 防水性能和剪裁让我印象深刻。但兜帽设计比较基础，在大风天气下无法提供足够的保护。

add.model: Mountain Equipment Makalu Jacket（Mountain Equipment Makalu 高山冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Mountain Equipment Makalu 高山冲锋衣
add.verdict: 这是一款曾经的测试冠军，方方面面都很出色。配置齐全、防护性好。专为登山设计，但作为徒步夹克同样表现出色。

add.model: Páramo Velez Adventure Light Smock（Páramo Velez Adventure Light 轻量套头冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Páramo Velez Adventure Light 轻量套头冲锋衣
add.verdict: 570克的重量，这是Páramo系列中较轻的Nikwax Analogy夹克之一。既有Páramo的透气防护，又没有沉重和臃肿。

add.model: Rab Latok Mountain Gore-tex Pro（Rab Latok Mountain Gore-Tex Pro 专业冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Rab Latok Mountain Gore-Tex Pro 专业冲锋衣
add.verdict: Rab在防水夹克方面很有一套。这款手感出色，具备我对高山冲锋衣所期望的所有细节，版型也允许内层叠穿。

add.model: Keela Pinnacle（Keela Pinnacle 全天候冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Keela Pinnacle 全天候冲锋衣
add.verdict: 性价比很高。面料结实（因此稍重），腋下拉链很大，口袋能装下OS地图。是我们最喜欢的苏格兰品牌产品之一。

add.model: Harrier Exmoor Jacket（Harrier Exmoor 轻量冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Harrier Exmoor 轻量冲锋衣
add.verdict: 弹力、防水、相当轻量，还有一些不错的细节。适合恶劣天气下跑步的好夹克。

add.model: Montane Solution Jacket（Montane Solution 轻量冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Montane Solution 轻量冲锋衣
add.verdict: 环保方面令人印象深刻。除此之外，这是一款结实的夹克，大口袋、实用的通风设计和可靠的兜帽配置。我喜欢它的剪裁，下摆略长。

add.model: Highlander Munro（Highlander Munro 经济冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Highlander Munro 经济冲锋衣
add.verdict: 这是一款结实的3层冲锋衣，手感和性能不逊于任何Gore-Tex Pro夹克，但价格只是零头。我试了常规码和大一码，更喜欢大一码的。

add.model: Outdoor Research Aspire 3L Jacket（Outdoor Research Aspire 3L 全天候冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Outdoor Research Aspire 3L 全天候冲锋衣
add.verdict: 又一款轻量夹克，舒适的弹力面料适合快速行进。透气性也很不错。

add.model: Jack Wolfskin Prelight 2.5L（Jack Wolfskin Prelight 2.5L 轻量冲锋衣）
add.chineseName: Jack Wolfskin Prelight 2.5L 轻量冲锋衣
add.verdict: 小到可以塞进裤兜或背包腰带，但依然防水且功能齐全。不要期待暴风雨级别的防护，但足以应对大雨。
